blocks.text: HANGS Construction Services LLC. Invented procedures for a software demonstration.

Age each open invoice from its invoice date: 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days at month-end. The aging total must equal GL 1200 Accounts Receivable and the retainage schedule must equal GL 1210 Retainage Receivable to the cent. Retainage is not aged; it falls due under each contract's terms.
Retainage held equals the contract's retainage rate on the work billed to date, less retainage released. Retainage is billed for release only when the contract's conditions for release are met.

Apply every receipt to the invoices it pays in the month it is received. A receipt without a remittance advice is matched by customer and amount. A receipt left in 2050 Unapplied Customer Payments at month-end is investigated and applied before the books close.
Bill a change order once the owner has signed it, for the work completed on it, on the next pay application. An unsigned change order is not billed.
An agreed credit is issued as a credit memo in the month it is agreed and applied to the invoice it relates to.

Send a reminder letter at 31 days and a past-due letter at 61 days. Past 90 days, the Controller calls the customer using the collections call script and the account is placed on credit hold. On a private job, ask counsel to confirm the lien deadline; the policy's working date is 90 days after the last day work was furnished.

At month-end, after the month's corrections, the allowance equals 1% of invoices 0-30 days old, 3% of 31-60, 10% of 61-90 and 25% over 90 days. Retainage is reserved only by a specific decision. Adjust 1290 Allowance for Doubtful Accounts against 6990 Bad Debt Expense.
The Controller reviews every proposed entry and approves every letter before it is sent. The preparer posts nothing and sends nothing.
Appendix A. Accounts Used in Receivable Entries

rows: Net billings less receipts and credits
